# ehrtslib 0.12.0

Runtime bundle from [ErikSundvall/ehrtslib](https://github.com/ErikSundvall/ehrtslib) release `v0.12`, Apache-2.0. The page uses `validateFlatPayload` and `RMSpecificationValidator`. The bundle does not export an OPT XML serializer; `templates/thumb-pain.opt` is the readable skeleton of the same node tree as `templates/thumb-pain.webtemplate.json`.
